FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 26
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator April Weaver
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/23/2025
Senate Bill 26 as introduced would decrease sales and use tax receipts to the Education Trust
Fund by approximately $32,000 annually, beginning in Fiscal Year 2026, based on information
provided by the entity, by exempting Sleep in Heavenly Peace, from paying state sales and use
taxes.
This bill could also decrease sales and use tax receipts to counties and municipalities, by an
estimated $42,000, annually dependent on the amount of taxable supplies purchased in the
county or municipality.
